reviews.text: It's fine if they limit it to examinations, spay/neuter surgery, and vaccinations, but the facilities that pet owners expect from a veterinary clinic are lacking.

We had a stray cat spayed.

The procedure was explained thoroughly, and the surgery went smoothly.
The cat is now living happily with its new owner.

Your gentle demeanor immediately conveyed your love for animals.

We would definitely like to use your services again if the opportunity arises.

He truly loves animals and is a very caring and wonderful teacher.
I've moved so I can't visit him often, but he is the best teacher in my opinion.
Is this your cat's regular veterinarian?

The doctor was incredibly kind. The prices were also very reasonable. Last year, my cat had eye problems and we took her to the vet. This time, it was frequent urination, so we delayed seeing her for a few days. She patiently explained the cause to us. She even wrote down the medical terms on paper, worried we wouldn't understand, since they were in Chinese characters and easy to read. Throughout the consultation, she patiently answered all our questions. She's truly a warm and loving person who cares deeply about cats. The clinic is run by just one doctor, so appointments are required in advance. You can book through Line. They respond very quickly. We are truly grateful.
